description: Pulse Wave 6.1.9 — Dynamic UI-synchronized Adobe 'Pw' App Icons, Apple Music Light Mode with porcelain surfaces, cute animated Day/Night switch with smiling sun & sleepy moon, and fluid physics-based dark/light theme morphing.

changelog.title: Dynamic Adobe 'Pw' App Icon System
items: Dynamic UI-Responsive Logo: App icon changes automatically to match the active UI accent color and Day/Night mode, both in-app and on the Android launcher.
5 Flat & Plain Pastel Colorways: Soft Pastel Lavender, Soft Pastel Sky, Soft Sage Mint, Soft Warm Rose, and Soft Porcelain Light Mode.
Android 13+ Themed Icons: Added pure vector monochrome icon (ic_launcher_mono.xml) so the launcher icon seamlessly adopts system wallpaper and Material You dynamic theming.
App Icon Style Selector: Added in Appearance Settings with automatic theme synchronization and manual selection options.
Live In-App Preview: Real-time Adobe 'Pw' squircle preview in Theme Settings and About screen that actively morphs colors as themes are selected.

changelog.title: Apple Music Light Mode & Fluid Transitions
items: Apple Light Mode Surfaces: Clean, luminous porcelain and snow-white surfaces (#F8F9FA, #FFFFFF) with crisp slate outlines and typography.
Cute Animated Theme Switch: Smiling golden sun with rotating sunbeams and floating cloud vs sleepy crescent moon with blushing cheeks and twinkling stars.
Fluid Theme Morphing: Smooth physics-based spring color interpolation across all surfaces, cards, and text when toggling between Day and Night.

changelog.title: Butter-Smooth Apple Music iOS 18 Startup
items: Hardware-accelerated native splash exit animation: seamlessly zooms the Adobe 'Pw' squircle (1.0x to 1.15x) and softly dissolves into the Home screen in 320ms via PathInterpolator curve.
Permanently eliminated startup glitches: removed the double Activity intent jump from WelcomeActivity on returning launches, pointing Launcher directly to MainActivity.
Fixed white window background flash by setting windowBackground to luxury obsidian #08080A.
Zero dropped frames: removed heavy Compose infinite ripple loops and double-scale transformations that previously contested with database initialization.

changelog.title: Desktop Sync & Spotify Features
items: PulseWave Desktop Companion App: Full cross-platform desktop player with local Wi-Fi playlist synchronization.
Persistent Keystore Signature: Updates never reset login session, cache, or imported playlists.
Spotify Features: Swipe-to-Queue, Song Radio, and Green Heart favorites.
